title: Stage 2: A naive Dockerfile
summary: Get the API running in a container the simplest way, then measure what that costs.

steps.title: The simplest thing that works
body: It works. It also ships the **entire SDK** (compilers, MSBuild, NuGet caches, your source) and re-downloads every NuGet package whenever any file changes, because `COPY . .` comes before the restore that `publish` does.

steps.prompt: Why does the `docker run` above publish `-p 8080:8080`, not `-p 8080:80`?
options: .NET 8+ images listen on port 8080 by default (so they can run as non-root)
steps.explain: `ASPNETCORE_HTTP_PORTS` defaults to 8080 in the official images.

steps.prompt: The database runs on the developer's machine, not in a container. Why `Host=host.docker.internal` and not `localhost`?
options: Inside the container, localhost is the container itself; host.docker.internal resolves to the host on Docker Desktop
steps.explain: In stage 4 the database moves into Compose and the host becomes the service name `db`.

steps.prompt: The container is running. What does this print?
steps.explain: Name, then the published mapping: all host interfaces, port 8080, to container port 8080 over TCP.

steps.prompt: Match each problem of the naive image to its consequence.
pairs: an image of roughly 900 MB with compilers inside
every code edit re-downloads all NuGet packages
bin/obj and .git are sent and copied into the image

steps.title: How big is it?
prompt: Each line is a Dockerfile instruction with the size in MB of the layer it adds: `"RUN dotnet publish -c Release -o /app|95"`. For a `FROM` line, the number is the size of that base image. Write `string Size(List<string> layers)` that returns the size of the **final image**: the base of the **last** `FROM` plus every layer after it.
Format: `TOTAL MB (base BASE MB + ADDED MB added)`.
solution: return $"{baseSize + added} MB (base {baseSize} MB + {added} MB added)";
template: var dojoNaive = new List<string> { "FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:9.0|840", "WORKDIR /src|0", "COPY . .|60", "RUN dotnet publish -c Release -o /app|95", "WORKDIR /app|0", "ENTRYPOINT [\"dotnet\", \"TodoApi.dll\"]|0" };
Dojo.Eq("naive image", "995 MB (base 840 MB + 155 MB added)", Size(dojoNaive));

var dojoMulti = new List<string> { "FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:9.0 AS build|840", "COPY . .|1", "RUN dotnet publish -o /app|95", "FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:9.0|220", "COPY --from=build /app .|12", "ENTRYPOINT [\"dotnet\", \"TodoApi.dll\"]|0" };
Dojo.Eq("multi-stage counts only the last stage", "232 MB (base 220 MB + 12 MB added)", Size(dojoMulti));
hints: Reset both totals whenever you meet a FROM.
